module_families.decision: Spend power, mass, and two cells to protect crew and refuge compartments.
module_families.weakness: The room contributes no attack and loses its protection when its staffed adjacency breaks.
module_families.repair_consequence: Restoring the Infirmary or its adjacent Crew Quarters restores Nera Quill's mitigation.

module_families.decision: Trade a staffed bay and heat for faster, riskier route doctrine.
module_families.weakness: Run Hot saves a day but adds four risk points, and damage to either staffed room removes Sela's feint.
module_families.repair_consequence: Restoring the Command Deck or its adjacent Crew Quarters restores route acceleration and the feint.

support_module.decision: Give up exterior capacity to brace lower-hull demolition attacks and recover one damaged system afterward.
support_module.weakness: It consumes one exposed mount and one power without replacing a general-purpose weapon.
support_module.repair_consequence: Clearing the Empty Mile restores one durability to the weakest system, or sells fittings for eight Ashmarks when the fortress is whole.

specialists.effect: Run Hot routes take one fewer day, add four risk points, and enable a command feint against scouts and Signal Hunters.
Crew and refuge compartments take one less incoming damage while the staffed infirmary remains Ready.
